snippet.title: Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A new mystery takes the legendary Chicken Police into the most dangerous part of Clawville: The Hive. Is this the case that will finally get Sonny and Marty killed?

Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! is the second game in the Chicken Police saga and features new stories, locations, characters, and mysteries to be solved. All are supported by new & improved visuals, the brand new Technicolor mode and a cast featuring a lot of faces familiar to some.

Wishlist Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! on Steam: https://bit.ly/3P25A4I
